title: Panda eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#8fa8c8'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#eef3fb'/>
    <!-- arms -->
    <ellipse cx='27' cy='72' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#7d97ba' transform='rotate(25 27 72)'/>
    <ellipse cx='73' cy='72' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#7d97ba' transform='rotate(-25 73 72)'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='24' fill='#eef3fb'/>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx='30' cy='20' r='8' fill='#8fa8c8'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='20' r='8' fill='#8fa8c8'/>
    <!-- eye patches -->
    <ellipse cx='39' cy='40' rx='8' ry='10' fill='#6f88ad' transform='rotate(-18 39 40)'/>
    <ellipse cx='61' cy='40' rx='8' ry='10' fill='#6f88ad' transform='rotate(18 61 40)'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='3.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='40' r='3.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='1.6' fill='#2b3a55'/>
    <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='1.6' fill='#2b3a55'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#5c7aa3'/>
    <!-- mouth -->
    <path d='M46 54 Q50 58 54 54' stroke='#5c7aa3' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- snack: bamboo stick held up -->
    <rect x='62' y='46' width='5' height='30' rx='2.5' fill='#7ec96b' transform='rotate(20 64 60)'/>
    <rect x='62' y='46' width='5' height='30' rx='2.5' fill='#5fae4e' transform='rotate(20 64 60)' opacity='0.35'/>
    <!-- leaf -->
    <ellipse cx='72' cy='48' rx='7' ry='3.5' fill='#8fe07a' transform='rotate(-30 72 48)'/>
    <!-- paw holding stick -->
    <circle cx='66' cy='60' r='6' fill='#7d97ba'/>
  </g>
</svg>
